output.reason: The changelog entry [ev-fac54af24634] is the v3 routing-syntax change. The upgrade guide [ev-48d8875989c1] says the default rule syntax is now v3 and v2 is deprecated. It also says matchers were renamed (Headers→Header) and that PathPrefix no longer takes a regex, regexp matchers now use Go regexp syntax, and each matcher takes a single value. The proposed assertion reduces this to the new optional CRD field spec.routes[].syntax [ev-08274e476e86][ev-b15a80a9b42b]. Its exposure condition, any IngressRoute or IngressRouteTCP v1alpha1 in use, is too broad: it flags every CRD user, not just routers whose rules use v2-only syntax without syntax/defaultRuleSyntax set to v2. It is also too narrow, because routers defined through other providers are missed. A correct assertion needs a different subject (the rule syntax default and matcher changes), so this field-added assertion cannot be fixed by changing only its applicability.
